```lean
import Mathlib

open Nat

/-- The largest natural `n` with `n ! < 3 ^ n`. Must be a numeric literal. -/
abbrev p10_answer : ℕ := 6

/-- `p10_answer` is the greatest element of `{n : ℕ | n ! < 3 ^ n}`. -/
theorem p10_factorial_pow :
    IsGreatest {n : ℕ | Nat.factorial n < 3 ^ n} p10_answer := by
  refine ⟨?mem, ?bound⟩
  · -- membership of `6`
    have : Nat.factorial 6 < 3 ^ 6 := by norm_num
    simpa using this
  · -- any `n` satisfying the inequality is ≤ `6`
    intro n hn
    have hle_or : n ≤ 6 ∨ 6 < n := le_or_gt n 6
    cases hle_or with
    | inl hle => exact hle
    | inr hgt =>
        -- from `6 < n` we get `7 ≤ n`
        have h7 : 7 ≤ n := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hgt
        -- prove that for every `m ≥ 7` we have `3 ^ m ≤ m!`
        have hpow_le_fact : ∀ m, 7 ≤ m → 3 ^ m ≤ Nat.factorial m := by
          intro m hm
          -- write `m = 7 + k`
          obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hm
          -- prove by induction on `k`
          have : ∀ k, 3 ^ (7 + k) ≤ Nat.factorial (7 + k) := by
            intro k
            induction k with
            | zero =>
                simpa using (by norm_num : 3 ^ 7 ≤ Nat.factorial 7)
            | succ k ih =>
                have hprev : 3 ^ (7 + k) ≤ Nat.factorial (7 + k) := ih
                have h3le : (3 : ℕ) ≤ 7 + k + 1 := by
                  have : (3 : ℕ) ≤ 7 + k := le_trans (by decide) (Nat.le_add_left _ _)
                  exact Nat.le_succ_of_le this
                have hmul :
                    (3 : ℕ) * 3 ^ (7 + k) ≤ (7 + k + 1) * Nat.factorial (7 + k) :=
                  Nat.mul_le_mul h3le hprev (Nat.zero_le _) (Nat.zero_le _)
                simpa [pow_succ, Nat.factorial_succ, add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc,
                       mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using hmul
          simpa using this k
        have hnot : ¬ Nat.factorial n < 3 ^ n := by
          have hle : 3 ^ n ≤ Nat.factorial n := hpow_le_fact n h7
          exact not_lt.mpr hle
        exact (hnot hn).elim
```
